en.headline: 24 commits on 2026-10-23: sopen-translate viewport and provider work
en.summary: On 2026-10-23 the user logged **24 own commits** across two repositories. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` there were 23 own commits: provider work added the keyless Google web endpoint as an unverified preset plus Microsoft MT and an optional LLM review pass, protocol-id lookup was switched to own-property checks, and the review budget was capped per page rather than per batch. Page performance also changed: viewport batches are capped so the first translation lands sooner, and the viewport is translated first with the rest continuing on scroll. Plan docs recorded the Microsoft MT and optional review acceptance, the viewport-first acceptance with the batch-shape fix, and an assessment of proxy options for Index-Translate by user experience. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` there was 1 own commit, which took the minimax and longcat free fallbacks offline and left the chain as `deepseek → sensenova`, plus **22 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`**. No pull requests, reviews, issues, releases, stars, discussions, or replies were recorded.

zh.headline: 2026-10-23 共 24 次提交：sopen-translate 视口与 provider 改动
zh.summary: 2026-10-23，用户在两个仓库共记录 **24 次本人提交**。其中 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 有 23 次本人提交：provider 方面新增了免密钥的 Google 网页端点（作为未验证预设）、Microsoft MT 以及可选的 LLM 审查环节，协议 id 查找改为自有属性判断，审查预算由按批次改为按页面设上限。页面性能也有调整：限制视口批次规模，让首次翻译更早出现；优先翻译视口内容，其余部分随滚动继续处理。计划文档记录了 Microsoft MT 与可选审查的验收结论、视口优先及批次形态修复的验收结论，以及针对 Index-Translate 按用户体验评估代理方案的调研。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 1 次本人提交，下线 minimax 与 longcat 两条免费回退，链路调整为 `deepseek → sensenova`，另有 **22 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 完成的自动提交**。当日没有 PR、审查、issue、发布、star、讨论或回复记录。
